scenes.say: How do you keep cloud costs low and queries fast? Let’s break down cost control and query optimization.

scenes.label: Partition
scenes.sub: Partition tables by date or integer to scan only relevant data.
scenes.say: Partitioning tables, like by date, means your queries scan only what’s needed, saving money and speeding things up.
Always select only the columns you need and filter data early. Avoid SELECT star and unnecessary scans.
Regularly review query plans and billing reports. Schedule heavy queries during off-peak hours for lower rates.

scenes.question: What’s a common cost control mistake?
scenes.right: SELECT * scans all columns, wasting resources and money.
scenes.say: Interviewers hate seeing SELECT star. It scans everything and drives up costs—always select only what you need.
